rationale: John and Jamie share a strong conviction that agentic AI is the next frontier—John sees it as autonomous action beyond chat, while Jamie is actively building it at scale through Mastt's construction AI platform serving 500+ projects. John's deep expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and ML systems, combined with his community leadership at Code and Coffee, could provide valuable operational and technical mentorship as Jamie scales his global engineering team.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Jamie Cerexhe — Jamie is building the agentic AI future you're bullish on through Mastt's construction automation platform, and your cloud infrastructure and ML expertise could be a valuable sounding board as he scales.
